steps: Create a Twilio project and copy its Account SID and Auth Token.
Add an approved sender number and configure the delivery-status webhook.
Save, enable, and run a connection test.
Enable the Twilio WhatsApp sender or sandbox.
Enter the Twilio Account SID, Auth Token, and approved WhatsApp sender.
Save and test before sending patient notifications.
Create a restricted Stripe secret key with only the required permissions.
Create a webhook endpoint and store its whsec signing secret separately.
Test the connection; webhook callbacks never initiate a second charge.
Complete OAuth authorization and enter the short-lived access token.
Enter the company Realm ID and select sandbox or production.
Reconnect before token expiry; use CSV export as a controlled fallback.
Expose the Orthanc REST endpoint over a trusted network or HTTPS.
Enter the server URL and optional Basic Auth credentials.
The health check reads /system without changing studies.
